supersedes: suburbs.json for the suburb LIST. suburbs.json remains authoritative for the 15 researched suburbs' deep content fields.
hard_rules: Do NOT build a suburb page for Camden itself. The homepage owns 'concreters camden'.
Do NOT invent any field marked REQUIRED-RESEARCH. A suburb with unfilled research fields builds as draft + noindex.
Do NOT build an intersection page unless intersection_differentiators[service] is non-empty and factual.
Never pad to hit a page-count quota. Page count is an output of available real material.
Only Tier 1 suburbs ship as publish. Everything else ships as draft.
intersection_rule: Build /{service-slug}-{suburb-slug}/ ONLY where intersection_differentiators[service] exists. Target ~3 per suburb, average. Two is fine. Zero is fine. Never pad.
